title: 第5章 贵人出狱第6章 司狱恩情
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
从天牢出来，林铭向着茶楼的方向而去，昨天的《小三侠》还没听完，今天还要继续去听才是！
沿路而行，发现路边有不少乞讨之人。
往昔碰到这些人的时候，林铭都会默默路过，他并不是什么圣人？！
只是一个小小的天牢狱卒！
改变不了这个世界，也救不了那许多人！
对这种情况，他多半也都会当成视而不见！
可今天和一心道长的一番论述，让他改变了想法！
他需要功德！
日行一善！
积攒功德！
就算是以后有什么罪孽，也尽可能用更多的功德来进行冲刷！
他略微犹豫了一下，来到了路边的馒头铺，买了十个馒头，拎着馒头，继续向着茶楼方向行进，这一路上，凡是遇到的乞讨之人，这一次每个人一个馒头！
一共十个，发完为止！
得到他馒头的人，纷纷用那没有多少光亮的目光看着林铭，赶紧跪倒，千恩万谢！
“谢谢恩人，谢谢恩人！”
林铭也不停留，径直从他们的身边走过！
……
进入茶馆，伙计照常迎了上来，林铭也依旧是选择坐到了自己往常靠窗的位置上，说书先生还未上台，周围的茶客在相互聊着！
“听说了没？！”
“圣上又要加税了！”

“又加税？！”
“前年，去年不都加税了么？！如今这税收都已经加征到二十年后了？！今年怎么又加？！”
“还能是什么？！还不是圣上炼丹没钱了？！”
“哎！”
“丹药害人啊！”
炼丹！
林铭搜索了一下记忆！
宋文帝三年之前生了一场大病，从那之后，他开始醉心丹药，追求那长生之途！
只是宋朝内忧外患，国库空虚！
为了支撑炼丹所需，从前年开始，每年都加征税收！
如今这税收，已经收到了二十年后！
宋朝这般样子，能不能维持到二十年后还是两说，税是先收到了二十年后！
今年再加征，不知道会加征到哪一年去？！
林铭听着别人的议论，也没有想要参言的意思，加征就加征，再怎么加征，也征不到他的头上！
content_en:
After coming out of the prison, Lin Ming headed towards the teahouse. He hadn't finished listening to "The Little Three" yesterday, so he had to continue listening to it today!
As I walked along the road, I noticed a lot of people begging on the roadside.
In the past, when he met these people, Lin Ming would pass by silently. He was not a saint? !
Just a little jailer!
It can’t change the world, and it can’t save so many people!
He would probably turn a blind eye to this situation!
But today's discussion with Taoist Yixin made him change his mind!
He needs merit!
Do one good deed a day!
Accumulate merit!
Even if there are any sins in the future, try to wash them away with as much merit as possible!
He hesitated for a moment, then went to the steamed bun shop on the roadside and bought ten steamed buns. Carrying the steamed buns, he continued towards the tea house. Every beggar he encountered along the way was given a steamed bun this time!
Ten in total, while supplies last!
The people who got his steamed buns all looked at Lin Ming with their lackluster eyes, and quickly knelt down, thanking him profusely!
"Thank you benefactor, thank you benefactor!"
Lin Ming didn't stop and walked straight past them!
…
Entering the teahouse, the waiter greeted him as usual. Lin Ming also chose to sit in his usual seat by the window. The storyteller had not yet come on stage, but the tea guests around him were chatting with each other!
"Did you hear that?!"
"Your Majesty is going to raise taxes again!"
“Another tax increase?!”
"Weren't taxes increased the year before last and last year?! Now the taxes have been increased twenty years later?! Why are they increased again this year?!"
"What else could it be?! Hasn't the Holy One run out of money to make alchemy?!"
"Hey!"
"Elixirs harm people!"
Alchemy!
Lin Ming searched his memory!
Emperor Wen of the Song Dynasty suffered a serious illness three years ago. From then on, he became obsessed with elixirs and pursued the path to immortality!
It’s just that the Song Dynasty was suffering from internal and external troubles and the treasury was empty!
In order to support the needs for alchemy, taxes have been levied every year starting from the year before last!
Now this tax has been collected twenty years later!
Whether the Song Dynasty can be maintained like this for twenty years is still a matter of debate. The taxes will be collected first twenty years later!
There will be an additional levy this year. I wonder when the levy will be increased? !
Lin Ming listened to other people's discussions and had no intention of participating in the discussion. He just imposed additional levies. No matter how much levies were imposed, they would not be able to top him!
